scientific_integrity: The finite-sample conditional count law and the strict peak–valley direction are proved analytically from the ballot-prefix characterization, multinomial weights and a classical cyclic-rotation correspondence; finite exact checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Classical length-n parking functions only; no sharp large-n asymptotic for the positive peak–valley gap is asserted. The classical cyclic-rotation correspondence is cited. Priority relative to all historical generating-function literature is not independently established.
title: Truncated-binomial preference transfers and strict peak–valley bias in random parking functions
